title: Reconstructing fluid velocity fields from sparse sensors using a variational quantum algorithm
summary: Reconstructing fields governed by nonlinear partial differential equations (PDEs) from sparse measurements is a challenging task because the governing equations are strongly nonlinear and observations are available at only a few locations. Fluid velocity fields are a representative case. In this paper, we propose a variational quantum algorithm that reconstructs the solution over the entire spacetime domain at once.
